title: StarCraft returns in 2030 as an open-world shooter
summary: 10 years after the last StarCraft II expansion pack the series is finally being brought back to life. Blizzard originally tried to bring the StarCraft universe to the world of 3D shooters way back in 2002 with StarCraft: Ghost .
